newsitem.title: USA: Rauscher Pierce hires six from Alex. Brown.
newsitem.headline: Rauscher Pierce hires six from Alex. Brown.

text.p: Dallas-based Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc has added six muni professionals from Alex. Brown & Sons Inc to its New York office, including Jerry McNamara, former head of municipal trading at Alex.
Alex. Brown & Sons is a unit of Alex. Brown Inc.

In addition to McNamara, joining the firm's municipal sales and trading department were Carl Saling, Art Nicol and Paul Zimmerman. Margaret Guarino and Bob Foggio joined the firm's public finance department as investment bankers, according to a release from the firm.

"The expansion of our New York office is simply a continuation of our strategy of growing our municipal business in our primary markets," Robert Vanosky, executive vice president and director of the Fixed Income Group, said in the release. "We are excited that these professionals have joined the Rauscher Pierce Refsnes team. Their talent will help RPR strengthen client relationships and expand the firm's client base."

McNamara has joined the firm as a senior vice and manager of Municipal Institutional Fixed Income, the release said. He oversees all municipal institutional trading, underwriting and sales activities at RPR, managing 47 institutional fixed income employees in Dallas, Houston, New York City, San Antonio and San Francisco.
Prior to joining Alex. Brown, which has since exited the municipal business, McNamara was head of municipal bond trading at Prudential Securities Inc.

Nicol, Saling and Zimmerman have come aboard as senior investment executives in the firm's 20-member institutional sales department. Nicol and Saling have joined as senior vice presidents, while Zimmerman has been named vice president.

Guarino joined Rauscher as a senior vice president and managing director of RPR's Northeast Public Finance office in New York City. Foggio has been named a vice president in public finance. Both are "seasoned" housing finance specialists, the release said, adding that their addition marks the firm's entrance into the Northeast public finance market.
Rauscher Pierce numbers 131 municipal professionals and support staff located in 10 regional offices on the West Coast, the Southwest, Florida and the Northeast.
